traps: The release states no revenue or sales figure anywhere; any revenue number or revenue growth rate is invented.
No year-ago quarter: the quarter is compared only with 1Q26, and the year-over-year columns are YTD 2026 vs YTD 2025; 'up X% year over year' for 2Q26 is invented.

GAAP $14.5 billion / $3.48 vs adjusted (non-GAAP) $14.7 billion / $3.52: the small gap nets $2,638 million of identified-item charges against $2,483 million of favorable estimated timing effects, so it does not mean the quarter was clean.

The sequential GAAP jump (+$10,342 million) overstates the underlying move because 1Q26 GAAP carried $3,883 million of negative timing effects; adjusted earnings rose $5,908 million from $8,772 million.
'Highest Upstream production in more than two decades' excludes Middle East country volumes; reported production actually fell to 4,514 koebd from 4,594 koebd.

Non-GAAP labels: adjusted earnings, free cash flow, cash flow from operations excluding working capital, cash capex, and cash opex are non-GAAP; cash flow from operating activities and segment Earnings/(Loss) rows are GAAP.
Segment GAAP vs adjusted diverge sharply: Upstream $7,927 million GAAP vs $9,189 million adjusted; Energy Products $5,465 million GAAP vs $4,099 million adjusted.
Quarter vs YTD: the $13.0 billion of cash capex and the $1.2 billion of new structural cost savings are six-month figures; 2Q26 cash capex was $6,787 million.
Structural cost savings of $16.3 billion are cumulative since 2019 (non-GAAP basis), not savings achieved in 2026.

No guidance: the release gives no earnings, production, or capex guidance, and any such range is invented. The only forward items are operational: the fifth Guyana FPSO set sail with production startup on plan for 4Q26, increasing capacity by 250 Kbd (a headline bullet; a brief that reports it is correct and is not inventing guidance), and the planned 9% Permian CAGR through 2030.

Energy Products GAAP earnings swung to $5,465 million from a $1,262 million loss in 1Q26, but most of that swing is estimated timing effects (+2,546 in 2Q26 vs (3,355) in 1Q26); adjusted (non-GAAP) Energy Products earnings rose to $4,099 million from $2,799 million. A brief presenting the GAAP swing as an operating turnaround overstates it.
Issuer name: the release body says 'ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation today announced', while the filing header names Exxon Mobil Corporation; either name is correct.
Units: financial tables are in millions, the structural cost table is in billions, production is in koebd while Permian is in Moebd.
The $1.03 per share dividend is the declared third-quarter dividend, payable September 10, 2026; it is not part of 2Q26 distributions and the release does not call it an increase.
